listingMetadata.title: FloraFlow: Garden & Biophilic Space Designer
listingMetadata.shortDescription: Design a calming indoor meditation corner shaped around your light and space.
listingMetadata.fullDescription: FloraFlow helps you transform any indoor corner into a soothing, restorative biophilic sanctuary. Assess your space's natural light and dimensions, receive tailored plant placement guidance, and take doable steps to bring natural calm into your daily life.

screenshotCaptions.caption: Turn one indoor corner into a place for calm.
Get placement guidance shaped around your light and available room.
Save one doable change. Return to your corner.
